topic: Ownership vs. merit — 60% of billionaire wealth is inheritance, monopoly or crony connection

drafts.text: Richest 1% hold 45% of global wealth. Billionaire fortunes just hit $18.3T, up 81% since 2020. 60% of that stack traces to inheritance, monopoly, or crony ties — not merit. Not a crisis. A business model. On the menu soon: The Stretch. https://data-snack.com
